footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to ACRES Commercial Realty: includes an $83K income tax benefit; after $27.7M of preferred dividends. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 4.2% to $79.9M in 2025. Operating income rose 41.7% to $16.4M, a 20.6% margin.
Net income fell 97.4% to $239K, or $0.03 per share. Operating cash flow was $4.1M and free cash flow $4.1M, versus $19.4M; ACRES Commercial Realty returned $22.3M through buybacks.
